name: [Bright Tone] Yellow S Mic Stand Staff

sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 3XL.
Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF (cannot be stacked).
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 5.
Ability Power scales with the number of Light elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 4XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Light elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
